scene: dusk aangan: mother cooking on chulha, father returning on bicycle
slogan: Maa-Papa ki dua saath chalti hai, toh raaste khud aasaan ho jaate hain.

scene: winter sunrise potters lane: potter at chaak, drying matkas, brick kiln, women carrying matkas to well
slogan: Chaak pe ghoomti mitti bhi, MEHNAT se hi bartan banti hai.

scene: winter afternoon village rooftops: kids flying a kite with charkhi, dadi on charpai with peanuts and gur, kites in sky, mustard fields beyond
slogan: Chhat ki patangein aaj bhi dil ko UDAAN sikhati hain.

scene: misty winter sunrise river ghat: boatman poling a wooden boat with two villagers, stone steps with brass lotas, banyan tree, egrets, cows and mustard fields on far bank, mud houses with chulha smoke
slogan: Lehron se na lado, saath BEHNA seekho, kinara mil jayega.

scene: late-winter golden afternoon dirt road through mustard fields: two school boys sharing one bicycle with a pinwheel, mud hut with tube-well, neem tree, parrots, distant village with chulha smoke
slogan: Sachchi DOSTI mein kachche raaste bhi ghar se lagte hain.

scene: late-autumn harvest sunset: family sharing rotis on a charpai under a neem tree, haystacks, bullock cart with two white bullocks, thatched mud house with chulha smoke, birds flying home
slogan: Thaali mein roti, apno ka saath, yahi asli DHAN hai.

scene: post-monsoon golden late afternoon: lone tall taad (palmyra) palm on a field bund in shining paddy fields, school girl with umbrella walking head held high, buffalo in pond, tiled mud houses with hand pump and chulha smoke, faint rainbow
slogan: Taad ka ped akela sahi, par sar UTHAKE khada rehta hai.

scene: misty early-winter sunrise: three schoolkids with slates and cloth bags walking a winding pagdandi through young wheat fields to a whitewashed village school under a neem tree, farmer ploughing with two white bullocks and egrets, mud houses with chulha smoke
slogan: Pagdandi bhi chalte chalte hi RAASTA banti hai.

scene: misty winter night aangan: joint family (dadi on charpai, parents in shawls, two kids, puppy) warming hands around an alaav bonfire, whitewashed mud houses with hurricane lantern, buffalo under thatched shed, fog over fields, starry sky with crescent moon
slogan: Thandi raaton mein apno ka saath hi sabse garam ALAAV hai.

scene: sunny late-winter morning aangan: nani in shawl knitting a red sweater on a charpai, granddaughter holding the wool ball, kitten with yarn, pickle jars on parapet, clothesline of small sweaters, hand pump, guava tree, mustard fields beyond
slogan: Nani ke sweater mein dhaage kam, PYAAR zyada hota hai.

scene: early-spring sunrise at a mango orchard edge: dadu and grandson planting a mango sapling with a brass lota under a huge blossoming old mango tree, resting bullock cart and dog in its shade, stone well with pulley, women with baskets, thatched house with chulha smoke, parrots
slogan: Sabr se seencho, aaj ka chhota beej kal ghani CHHAAON ban jaata hai.

scene: golden monsoon evening after rain: brother and sister floating paper boats in a rainwater stream along a muddy village lane, puppy watching, mother smiling in doorway of red-tiled mud house, hand pump, bicycle, hens, dripping neem, paddy fields with egrets, sunset over hills
slogan: Kaagaz ki naav chhoti thi, par KHUSHIYAN bahut badi thi.

scene: late-autumn blue-hour dusk village chaupal: hurricane laltain hanging from a post under a neem tree, elders in shawls on charpais around a transistor radio, two kids on a durrie with a sleeping dog, whitewashed houses with lit windows, bullock in thatched shed, hand pump, mist over fields, crescent moon
slogan: Dheere jalne wali LALTAIN hi poori raat saath nibhati hai.

scene: late-winter blue-hour dusk on a field bund through sugarcane: tired farmer father walking home with hoe and sugarcane sticks, two kids running to him with a hurricane lantern, mother in lit doorway of thatched whitewashed house, cow in shed, hand pump, neem tree, chulha smoke, mist, crescent moon
slogan: Papa ki thakaan kabhi dikhti nahi, bas ghar ki ROSHNI ban jaati hai.

scene: golden late-afternoon winter village maidan by a pond: little girl learning to ride a big black bicycle kainchi-style while elder brother runs holding the carrier, two kids cheering on a mud wall, puppy and hens, huge banyan tree, buffalo and egrets at the pond, tiled whitewashed houses with chulha smoke, mustard fields, setting sun
slogan: Girke phir uthna, yahi cycle ka pehla SABAK hai.

scene: pre-monsoon golden late afternoon first rain on cracked dry fields: farmer couple looking up gratefully, two kids dancing in puddles, peacock on a stone wall, woman taking clothes off a line by a red-tiled house, matka catching rain, goats under neem tree, wooden plough, rainbow and birds
slogan: Pyaasi dharti hi jaanti hai har boond ki KEEMAT.

scene: bright winter late-morning: villagers finishing a newly dug well with a wooden tripod pulley, two farmers hauling up the first bucket of sparkling water, kids and puppy cheering, woman with clay matka, mound of fresh earth with shovels and baskets, bullock cart under neem tree, mustard fields, tiled whitewashed houses, parrots
slogan: Gehri khudai ke baad hi kuan meetha PAANI deta hai.

scene: misty golden late-winter morning on a wide village river: two teen friends in mufflers rowing a small wooden boat together, stone steps with woman rinsing a brass lota, tethered boat, fishing nets on bamboo poles, buffaloes wading, kingfisher and egrets, sarkanda grass, banyan tree, red-tiled houses with chulha smoke, mustard fields
slogan: Sachcha dost lehron mein bhi chappu SAATH chalata hai.
